name: Park Seo-Yeon
bio:
Park Seo-Yeon's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, sparked by a university project focused on vehicle dynamics. Initially pursuing a degree in mechanical engineering, she became fascinated by the intricacies of simulating real-world racing conditions. After graduating, she worked for a Korean automotive manufacturer, honing her skills in vehicle simulation and testing. A chance encounter with a racing team at an industry conference led to her transition into motorsport.

Seo-Yeon is known for her meticulous approach to simulator engineering. She believes in bridging the gap between the virtual and the real, constantly seeking ways to improve the accuracy and fidelity of the simulator. Her ability to identify subtle nuances in driver feedback and translate them into actionable adjustments to the simulator setup has made her a valuable asset to Garage 59. She is especially good with new drivers, ensuring they get the most value from their sim time.

What sets Seo-Yeon apart is her commitment to innovation. She is never content with the status quo, always exploring new technologies and methodologies to enhance the simulator experience. Her colleagues appreciate her willingness to share her knowledge and mentor junior engineers. Her deep understanding of vehicle dynamics, combined with her passion for motorsport, makes her a distinctive figure in the field.
